name: Nnenna Solís-Bergqvist
subcategory: purist distance running / PURIST OPEN legend
description: An Igbo-Swedish long-distance runner from Meridian's Tier 2 northern stack who completed the PURIST OPEN Great Lakes Circuit twelve consecutive times without a single registered augmentation — verified by quarterly full-body scans conducted by the independent Nullhand Athletic Club. Her 2204 world record on the 200-kilometer Lake Loop, set in driving late-autumn sleet at age thirty-one, remains unbroken in the unaugmented category and is considered by purist communities to be the most significant athletic achievement of the century. She trained using a self-designed regimen of hypoxic chamber sleep, harvested synth-protein microdosing, and obsessive biomechanical study conducted entirely on paper notebooks.
story_hooks: Someone has begun anonymously filing forged augmentation records against Solís-Bergqvist with the PURIST OPEN oversight body — and the pattern of filings suggests a corponation data team rather than a lone bad actor.

A young Shelf runner asks Solís-Bergqvist to train her, but the girl has a hidden geneware modification she received as an infant — a modification she didn't choose and can't remove — and the purist certification board is demanding she declare it.
Solís-Bergqvist's paper training notebooks go missing days before she is scheduled to testify at the Cartography Hearings on BCI classification in sport, and the notes contain more than running data.
